jobs.list.title: List jobs (legacy)
jobs.list.description: List job openings via GET /recruit/v2/Job_Openings mapped into the legacy NormalizedJob shape. Prefer job_openings.list for the dedicated job_opening model.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates via GET /recruit/v2/Candidates. Optional page, perPage, fields, sortBy, and sortOrder.

job_openings.list.title: List job openings
job_openings.list.description: List job openings via GET /recruit/v2/Job_Openings into NormalizedJobOpening. Optional page, perPage, fields, sortBy, and sortOrder.

applications.list.title: List applications
applications.list.description: List applications via GET /recruit/v2/Applications. Optional page, perPage, fields, sortBy, and sortOrder.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Zoho Recruit connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.
